On 30 Aug 2017, at 21:23 , Jane Li <jane...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi, May I ask in which situation that I need to conduct Muli-level CFA instead of single level CFA using Lavvan?

This question is not really about lavaan, but whether you should use multilevel modeling generally.  It depends on your research question and data characteristics. Center for Multilevel Modeling has some material that may be helpful in figuring out whether you need to include levels in your model:

http://www.bristol.ac.uk/cmm/learning/multilevel-models/what-why.html

Mikko


Thank you!
